Commercial painting

Painting for retail and fit-out projects in Sydney

A shop only earns money when the doors are open, so retail painting has to be fast, clean and worked around trade. We paint new fit-outs, refurbishments and shopfronts across Sydney, on a programme that keeps disruption to a minimum.

We are the painting trade on a retail fit-out, not the shopfitter. That means we take care of the surface preparation, feature walls, ceilings, joinery coating and shopfront finishing, and we slot into the builder or shopfitter's schedule so the space is ready for hand over on time.

From a single tenancy repaint to a full store roll out, we bring one accountable team, the right products for high traffic commercial surfaces, and finishes that match your brand.

props.label: Retail and fit-out painting questions
props.html:
Good to know

Retail and fit-out painting questions

Can you paint outside trading hours?

Yes. Most of our retail and hospitality work is staged after hours, overnight or early morning so the space is ready for trade. We plan the programme with you and use low odour products where the public returns quickly.

Do you work in shopping centres and follow site inductions?

Yes. We work to centre inductions, insurance requirements and out of hours access rules, and coordinate with centre management and your other trades so the works run smoothly.

Can you match our brand colours?

Yes. We match brand and design colours accurately across walls, features and joinery so the finished store is consistent with your fit-out design.

Do you paint shopfronts and exteriors as well as interiors?

We paint shopfronts, facades and entries along with the interior. These surfaces take weather and foot traffic, so we prepare and coat them with durable products suited to the exposure.

Do you work with shopfitters and builders?

Yes. On a fit-out we are the painting trade, working alongside your shopfitter or builder. We slot into the programme so painting happens at the right stage and hand over is not delayed.

How quickly can you turn around a store repaint?

It depends on the size and the finish, but retail repaints are usually staged over nights or a short closure to limit downtime. Tell us the space and your dates and we will give you a realistic programme in the quote.
